reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every real inner-product space E and every real kappa,define an extended-nonnegative cost on pairs of phase states by
  C_kappa(z,zprime)=ENNReal.ofReal(Q_kappa(z-zprime)),
where Q_kappa(x,p)=(1/(2kappa)+1/2)||x||^2+<x,p>+||p||^2 and subtraction is coordinatewise. For z=(x,p),zprime=(xprime,pprime),this is the ENNReal embedding of the nonnegative part of Q_kappa(x-xprime,p-pprime). The definition takes no square root and assumes no lower bound on kappa. It asserts no metric property,integrability or coupling existence.
objects: Real-inner-product E;real kappa;two phase states;coordinate difference;explicit real quadratic form Q_kappa;extended-nonnegative cost C_kappa.
domains: kappa in R;z,zprime in E x E;C_kappa:(E x E) x (E x E)->ENNReal. E needs real inner-product structure only;no measure is required by this function definition.
quantifiers: Definition for every real kappa and every phase-state pair. There is no conditional proposition,existential coupling or kappa>=1 requirement.
assumptions: Only E real-inner-product structure and well-typed inputs. The approved Q definition is used. kappa is arbitrary;the ENNReal.ofReal operation handles the real value as specified by standard ENNReal semantics.
conclusion: The cost function body is exactly ofReal(Q_kappa(z-zprime)). It is unrooted quadratic cost in ENNReal rather than a declared distance theorem.
scopes: Coordinate subtraction precedes Q evaluation;ofReal embeds the nonnegative part. This definition does not certify a metric,triangle inequality,positive-definiteness,transport infimum,measurability or probability condition. No material ambiguity is present.
constant_dependencies: Uses precisely Q position coefficient 1/(2kappa)+1/2,cross coefficient 1,momentum coefficient 1. There is no additional scale,power or square root. The cost depends only on kappa and the difference of the two states.
